'''Hoogenz''' was a [[Buktari]] who, alongside fellow Buktari [[Anonda]],<ref name="Leland" /> spent [[time]] in [[Niima Outpost]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Jakku]] during the [[New Republic Era|reign]] of the [[New Republic]].<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="TFADate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VII}} to [[34 ABY]].</ref> the pair stood together inside the outpost's<ref name="TFA" /> [[Concession Stand]],<ref name="TFAVD">''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> a tent operated by the [[junk dealer]] [[Unkar Plutt]], as the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] traded salvage with Plutt for [[Ration pack|portions]] while other scavengers queued behind her.<ref name="TFA" />

In the outpost, Hoogenz wore a [[Color|green]] [[Clothing|shirt]] and brown pants with a gray duster over them as well as a pair of brown [[boot]]s and a gray face mask with slitted eye covers and a hose running from the end of the mask's snout down to the Buktari's [[belt]]. The outfit matched that of Anonda. Hoogenz also carried<ref name="DB">{{Databank|niima-outpost|Niima Outpost}}</ref> a brown [[leather]] satchel<ref name="Leland" /> and a [[blaster rifle]].<ref name="DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Development and name===
{{Quote|They laughed at me when I said I wanted to run an oil bath for droids on Jakku. Well, who's laughing now? Actually, it's still them. It seems I've got a few leaky pipes in the system. Patch them up with some salvage and I'll make it worth your while.|Hoogenz in ''Disney Infinity 3.0''|<ref name="DI3.0">''[[Disney Infinity 3.0]]''</ref>}}
Hoogenz was created for the [[sequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]<ref name="TFA" /> on [[December 18]], [[2015]].<ref name="Release">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-force-awakens-play-set-for-disney-infinity-3-0-edition-now-available|text=''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Play Set for ''Disney Infinity 3.0 Edition'' Now Available}}</ref> The character was one of two Buktari characters based on designs for a desert scavenger by [[Jake Lunt Davies]]. Davies produced one piece of concept art for the design on [[November 26]], [[2013]]<ref name="Leland" /> and another titled "Bounty Hunter Sand Man C010."<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref>

The name Hoogenz did not appear in the film<ref name="TFA" /> but was first used in the ''The Force Awakens'' update to the [[Avalanche Software]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Disney Infinity 3.0]]''<ref name="DI3.0" /> which was released on the same day as the film.<ref name="Release" /> Despite the game being non-[[canon]], [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Pablo Hidalgo]] confirmed on [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] that the names provided by the game for previously unidentified characters were considered canon.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/749616406245699584|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2016-07-03|quote=@LelalMekha Yeah, same with Infinity.|archivefile=File:PabloHidalgo-LegoName-Twitter.png|nolive=1}} {{C|In response to: "@pablohidalgo <nowiki>youtube.com/watch?v=JwxAeHPLpPg</nowiki> The Lego game identifies a few BG characters from TFA, but are those names canonical?"}}</ref>

===Game appearances===
{{Quote|Thanks! Now all I need is some droid customers. But that seems like a minor detail.|Hoogenz thanks the player for completing Oil's Well in ''Disney Infinity 3.0''|<ref name="DI3.0" />}}
In ''Disney Infinity 3.0'', players can encounter Hoogenz stood beside an [[oil bath]] in Niima Outpost. If spoken too, the Buktari informs the player that people laughed at them for wanting to run an oil bath for [[droid]]s on Jakku and then asks the player to use salvage to repair several leaks in the pipes leading to the bath. This begins the quest "Oil's Well," which unlocks Hoogenz as a useable character if completed within a certain time limit. Once the player repairs all the leaks, they turn on the oil bath and the Buktari thanks them, the admits they now need to find some droid customers.<ref name="DI3.0" />

[[File:Hoogenz-LEGOTFA.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=A LEGO version of Hoogenz stands at an ice cream cart holding an ice cream cone in hand in Niima Outpost. A human stands at the cart as BB-8 approaches.|Hoogenz was shown selling ice cream in ''LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens''.]]
Hoogenz also appeared in the [[2016]] non-canon Traveller's Tales video game ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'', where the Buktari can be seen running an [[ice cream]] stand in Niima Outpost during the third chapter. Completing the chapter unlocks Hoogenz as a playable character of the scavenger type who uses a [[blaster pistol]].<ref name="LEGO">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref> Neither game specified which of the two Buktari in Episode VII was Hoogenz<ref name="DI3.0" /><ref name="LEGO" /> but Lucasfilm Story Group member [[Leland Chee]] clarified on [[Wikipedia:Instagram|Instagram]] in [[2023]] that Hoogenz has a brown leather satchel in the film, while Anonda has a canvas olive-gray satchel.<ref name="Leland" />
